LESSON: ULUMUL QUR’AN

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an
Topic 1.1: Ulumul Qur’an

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Ulumul Qur’an. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why was the Qur’an revealed to mankind?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. state the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind
2. describe the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an as a sign of mercy to mankind
3. explain the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an in portions for ease of its implementation
4. value the Qur’an as a book of guidance to mankind

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: ULUMUL QUR’AN
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Ulumul Qur’an helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: ULUMUL QUR’AN
Study Ulumul Qur’an like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: State the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind

What this means
In this part you learn to state the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: state the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Ulumul Qur’an” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can state the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Describe the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an as a sign of mercy to mankind

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an as a sign of mercy to mankind. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an as a sign of mercy to mankind.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Ulumul Qur’an in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an as a sign of mercy to mankind. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Explain the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an in portions for ease of its implementation

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an in portions for ease of its implementation. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an in portions for ease of its implementation.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an in portions for ease of its implementation. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Value the Qur’an as a book of guidance to mankind

What this means
In this part you learn to value the Qur’an as a book of guidance to mankind. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: value the Qur’an as a book of guidance to mankind.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Ulumul Qur’an” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can value the Qur’an as a book of guidance to mankind. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Ulumul Qur’an is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Ulumul Qur’an” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: state the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Ulumul Qur’an in your own words. (skill: describe the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an as a sign of mercy to mankind)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: explain the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an in portions for ease of its implementation)

Example 4: Show how “Ulumul Qur’an” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: value the Qur’an as a book of guidance to mankind)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Ulumul Qur’an to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: state the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind.
3. Practise this skill: describe the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an as a sign of mercy to mankind.
4. Practise this skill: explain the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an in portions for ease of its implementation.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Ulumul Qur’an from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Ulumul Qur’an: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Ulumul Qur’an?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why was the Qur’an revealed to mankind?
2. How does the Qur’an guide mankind?
3. How did Muslims benefit from the revelation of the Qur’an in portions?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Ulumul Qur’an means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: state the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind.
5. Be able to: describe the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an as a sign of mercy to mankind.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
